verdict.rationale: Evidence only indirectly touches multi-provider account connection: docs mention contacts syncing with Office 365 and Google (missive-docs-23), and a community thread implies a user actually routes Gmail/Yahoo mail through Missive (missive-comm-1). There is no explicit documentation describing adding multiple Gmail, Microsoft 365, and generic IMAP accounts into one unified inbox. Missing for 10: explicit docs on connecting Gmail/O365/IMAP accounts simultaneously, a unified-inbox walkthrough, and independent hands-on confirmation of multi-account switching.
